source: PixelLab character 89dc779e (south-east rotation, robe stretched 7 rows) animated with animate_image_pixminimax; frames snapped to the 8-colour palette, specks < 12 px removed, pieces lifted so feet sit on the bottom row. cast_gesture (9 frames, the Knight's timings) = cast f2, f4, f6, f7, victory f5 (hand pulled back = the coil, frame 4 = the cast pack's gesture_hold_frame), victory f6 x2 (palm out = the slash, frame 5), victory f5, cast f8. See design/assets/specs/mage-assets.md. draw and the dash clips (step_forward / step_back / step_down) are recentred on the head (x 47) because the game glides the unit; step_up was rejected (turns to a back view), the up step plays `step`. idle replaced 2026-11-05 by anim03/idle_v3 (PixMiniMax, first and last frame pinned to the anchor, positive breathing prompt; raw f0-f7, f8 = f0 dropped).

clips.note: 2026-11-15 Ilva (no hat, user 'Bỏ mũ'): regenerated from the stretched v3 anchor (design/assets/candidates/mage/ilva-2026-11-15/v3-rot-tall/south-east-tall.png) with animate_character pixminimax, positive-only motion. Cleaned mechanically: snapped to the anchor's 6 colours, clusters under 12 px dropped, each frame replanted so its bottom row is 69, padded 84->96 wide and cropped to 96x70. The five movement clips are worded as the Swordsman v7 dash (hold ONE leaning shape, end upright), not the 2026-11-04 wording that produced a march.
